events.description: Baseline state. Pre-monsoon conditions. All monitoring cells stable.
Monsoonal rainfall system approaching. Rainfall intensity increasing over high-elevation zones.
Intense rainfall continuing. Antecedent saturation accumulating on steep slopes. Soil moisture index elevated.
AI model detects critical risk on steep slopes. Warning thresholds crossed. Triggering early warning protocol.
Critical risk zones intersecting NH-10 corridor. 2 cell(s) pose direct highway risk. Recommended: Alert BRO clearing crews and NDMA.
recommended_actions: Alert Border Roads Organisation (BRO) clearing teams on NH-10
Notify NDMA State EOC — North Sikkim district
Issue traffic advisory: Reduce speed / stop non-essential traffic on NH-10
Dispatch drone survey team to critical slope areas
Alert Mangan district disaster management cell
Initiate field verification by SDRF teams
